settings.text: We love this question! Scooch supplements are not only vet-formulated and packed with clinically proven ingredients to actually make a difference, but each chew is also human grade, hypoallergenic and free of all nasties to ensure the highest quality is there for our dogs. Not to mention our focus on sustainability to protect the planet our dogs love so much, with all supplements being meat-free and wrapped up in eco-friendly, recyclable packaging.
